summary.text: Regina Lewis-Ward represents District 115 in the Georgia House of Representatives; she was elected in 2020 and sworn in on January 11, 2021.

paragraphs.text: Lewis-Ward is a native of Brooklyn, New York, with a BBA from Baruch College and an MA in Political Science from Clayton State University.
She worked over 20 years in management at New York City Transit and served on the Stockbridge city council beginning in 2014.
